Name: Cute Bears (SVE)
Author: faerinym
Description:
This mod currently contains 3 Alternative Textures for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s bears (unlockable livestock). I'm working on additional textures!
Drawn to fit the aesthetic of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20044]Elle's Cuter animals[/url]!

Purchase the Scissors from Robin in order to change your bears' textures.



This is my first publish on Nexus ^_^
